commit r390
Author: jdog5000 <hidden>
Date:   2008-09-18 06:37:33 +0000

Gold AI
- AI now has a budget for troop upgrades each turn based on how much gold it wants to have, it won't spend more than this budget on non-critical units when at peace
- AI now prioritizes upgrading escort ships to same extent as transports

Naval AI
- Galleons assigned escort roles before Frigates are available will now change their UnitAI type to assault transport instead of getting stuck in their role after better escorts come along

Air Ai
- Many improvements to better handle damaged planes in threatened cities
- Added two functions for defensive airstrikes to make air units more directly aid in defending cities from enemy stacks

Espionage AI
- Revamped desired Espionage rate and priority weighting calculations, AI now always update weights, relations play a larger role
- Neutral priority weighting is now 10 instead of 0, differentiates between 
- When AI starts preparing for war against another player they will heavily shift their espionage spending towards that player
- AI will attempt to gain passive mission levels against adversaries

Bugfix
- Fixed bug stopping Aggressive AI from using espionage against enemies they were Pleased towards as intended

General AI
- Removed the unused partial implementation of a new A* solver for closeness

commit r234
Author: blakeciv <hidden>
Date:   2006-12-28 22:47:44 +0000

Happy Holidays I lost Part II so here it is:


Start Points: Now always take distance properly into consideration regardless of map script. Should be less polar starts since the "Push starts apart" factor has been weakened quite a lot.

Units: Promotions will be chosen more smartly, the AI should follow promotion lines better and have less mismatched promotions.
The AI will now build and use a few more pillagers, targeting strategics where possible. (towards these ends you can now pass a threshold to pillage functions, if set the AI will only pillage bonuses and only those meeting the threshold (compared directly with the AI_bonusVal))
The AI will build considerably more defenders.

commit r233
Author: blakeciv <hidden>
Date:   2006-12-28 22:38:20 +0000

Happy Holidays Mega Commit Part 1 (CvCityAI)
You can now use the BUILDINGFOCUS_WONDEROK flag, wonders will not be chosen unless WONDEROK or WORLDWONDER is set. WORLDWONDER if set alone excludes all non-worldwonder buildings. WONDEROK should not be set alone - it is intended to be used ONLY with other focusflags, if no flags are set then wonders are assumed to be ok.
Wonderbuilding in chooseProduction has been changed to make use of the new flag functionality.

You can now pass a threshold to "bestBuilding", this only looks at the Pass0 results and as such is only intended to be used with focusflags. buildingValue has been tweaked so that all building values are more comparable. This new functionality is used by OR'ing the gold, research, maintenance, happy, healthy and specialist flags and having it simply select the most profitable building from any of those - pruning those which don't meet the threshold.

Various changes to the best build (smarter chopping), better order of building improvements (cottages are higher priority).
AI Whipping has been fixed so it works again.
AI uses Emphasis buttons more selectively and they generally wont override the new city specialization stuff (ie cities pumping out a wonder wont decide to emp great people).
The governor should prefer production slightly more, he should also always prefer hamlets over cottages.

added a group version of canBombard
canMoveInto now returns true when bAttack is true and there is an empty city with no units
sea assault stacks which have units that can bombard will stop to bombard the city before returning to pick up more units
missionaries will strongly dislike spreading religion to other team's cities if they own at least one holy cities but not the holy city for that missionary's religion
land units will not bombard cities with zero enemies or when they have attack odds over 95%

big sea assault changes:

- AI_group and AI_groupMergeRange do not group if the unit is on a transport
- AI_load splits the group and loads the whole group that can fit onto the transport, it prefers transports that have enough room for as much of the group as possible

- AI_assaultSeaMove makes larget stacks

commit r120

commit r119
Author: iustus <hidden>
Date:   2006-11-25 06:13:51 +0000

findPopulationRank, findBaseYieldRateRank, findYieldRateRank, findCommerceRateRank all cached, they can now be called more liberally without performance penalties
getBuildingCommerceByBuilding cleaned up so that it does less work when commerce is going to be zero
AI_commerceWeight now reflects whether the player is going for a cultural victory, all the places that called this and then adjusted for cultural victory outside the call were adjusted
AI_specialistValue removed the 'hack' to prefer merchants if you emphasized commerce, now it picks each commerce type based on the player's commerce slider allocations (so if you doing 80% research, 10% culture, 10% gold and emph commerce, then you get 80% emph on research, 10% emph on gold, and 10% emph on culture, so scientists will get a boost, if the slider is moved to all culture, then artists will have the biggest boost)
if a city needs to pop borders (its culture level is under 2), we now will run culture process correctly in the case where we captured the city (in that case, the culture level is 1)
otherwise, if we just captured a city, and it is still in revolt, we will pick a building (food, production, then anything) rather than a unit
National and World wonders will be more likely to be built in appropriate cities (if its not the top 4 rank of whatever the wonder does, it gets low value)
Buildings that increase great people rate are more likely to be built in cities that already have a high great person rate
monastaries are more likely to be built under cultural victory strategy, or in the early game (more than 1 era prior to obselecence)
under cultural victory strat, temples are given high priority if there are not enough yet built to get a cathedral in the top 3 culture cities
we make sure we build cathedrals in the top culture cities first 
possible crash because parameters of DLLExport'ed AI_processValue removed, now we overload the function to add parameter
AI_processValue gives higher priority to culture process if we need to pop borders, also under cultural victory
AI_forceEmphasizeCulture added, since there is no EmphasizeInfo in XML to do this. This works just like regular emphasize calls, except it does not have an associated EmphasizeInfo
we now call AI_forceEmphasizeCulture(true) on the top 4 culture cities in cultural victory strat
we cache the number of cities needed for cultural victory, culturalVictoryNumCultureCities - you can also call culturalVictoryValid which uses the same cached value (zero means cultural victory is not valid)
limitedWonderClassLimit added, since isLimitedWonderClass does not specify how many you can build. this new function returns the number you can build (it adds up the numbers of each type, although in the default XML there are no wonders that are both national and world, but it is possible)
alt mouseover city under chipotle cheat mode shows the ranks for population, yields, commerce
alt mouseover player under chipotle cheat mode (which shows attitude) also shows if in financial trouble
getBuildingClassPrereqBuilding does almost zero work in the case where it is going to return zero
AI_religionValue does less work when it is going to return zero
if we get to cultural victory stage 2, dagger strat is forced off
AI_getBestGroupAttacker does less work when bForce is true
AI_sumStrength works correctly in the case where you need to declare war to move into the plot to be attacked
canMoveInto: check on !isHuman() removed when you would need to declareWar to move. Previously it would return false in this case. There is a temporary assert there now, to see when this happens. Currently it only seems to happen on sea-going exploring units and the case we wanted to catch, when a unit needs to attack to move into territory where it wants to declare war. 
divide by zero crash fixed when improper units were given great people missions (discover value would be zero)
AI_stackAttackCity now passes (bDeclareWar = true) to canMoveInto and (bPotentialEnemy = true) to AI_compareStacks

commit r107
Author: iustus <hidden>
Date:   2006-11-22 05:50:53 +0000

playerAI finance changes: it no longer runs 90% research almost all the time. It will again try to keep AI_goldTarget gold on hand, but it is willing to spend 2/3rds of it if doing so will finish the current tech research.

changed some area == area checks to getArea == getArea (area IDs), this avoids a hash table lookup, which may speed up some of the pathfinding a little. When comparing areas, it is fine to compare areaIDs, there is no need to do the lookup to find the actual area classes and compare pointers.

commit r102
Author: iustus <hidden>
Date:   2006-11-18 20:21:19 +0000

Fixed infinite looping bug with AI_heal. We now push a heal mission when we want to heal. AI_group will not join groups which have a heal activity. Every turn, when normally resetting group activities (CvSelectionGroup::doTurn), if we are isAutomated(), we reactivate groups which are set to heal, damaged or not. Previously, automated groups would never push heal missions. Now they can, knowing it will be cleared at the beginning of the next turn.

commit r76
Author: iustus <hidden>
Date:   2006-11-15 02:05:36 +0000

AI_bestTech changes: religious buildings are worth 1/7th as much, founding a religion is worth twice the random factor if you have zero religions. The net effect of this should be that Polytheism is much more likely to be chosen over Meditation. Prior to this change, Meditation was getting +2200 for its buildings (7 monastaries), while Polytheism was getting +800 for its two wonders). Now Meditation gets about +325, as it should be. Because Meditation will research in fewer turns, it still will be preferred, but the random factor will make it much more even than it was previously. The lost +2000 that meditation was getting is instead part of the possible doubling of the +2400 random if you would found the religion. Since this is always the case for meditation and polytheism early, this factor about evens out meditation to what it was previously, but it raises polytheism to close to the same level. Prior to the change, Meditation would be on average 4500*(180cost), Polytheism would be 3000*(230cost), now it is on average 3700*cost vs 4200*cost. The random factor is +/- 3400, making these two close to equal now.

Added the new AI_defines.h header file to the VS project
